name: AI Disco — Cert Refresh (strict URLs) — 15 day
description: Every 15 days: refresh certifications for 80 tools. Claude is instructed to only use URLs it is highly confident exist, and fall back to main learning hub URLs when uncertain.

metadata.__NOTE__: Every 15 days. Run on day 8 of cycle (Cases=day1, YouTube=day4, Certs=day8, UseCases=day15).
REPLACE API KEY. TIMEOUT MUST BE 180s. Compact response — only returns cert data, not full tool records.
Writes to separate certs.json file — does NOT overwrite tools.json. First run: create certs.json in repo with content W10= (base64 of [])

SETUP.1: Import as new scenario. Delete or pause your old cert-refresh scenario.
SETUP.2: Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN (2 places each)
SETUP.3: Type header Name fields manually after import: x-api-key, anthropic-version, content-type, Authorization, Accept, X-GitHub-Api-Version, User-Agent, Content-Type
SETUP.4: CRITICAL: Module 2 > Advanced Settings > Timeout = 180 (this is the #1 slowness fix)
SETUP.5: First run: manually create certs.json in the repo root with content [] (empty array). GitHub will assign a SHA.
SETUP.6: Schedule: every 15 days, day 8 of cycle
SETUP.7: This writes a SEPARATE certs.json, not tools.json — so it cannot damage your tool data. Frontend will merge them.
